range.quote: We tested the Via Pro’s range by riding in PAS 5 and PAS 1 until the bike’s 48V, 687 Wh battery expired, using Strava to track our mileage. Flyer advertises a range of 30 to 50 miles on a single charge, and our results exceeded both ends of this estimated range; we measured 38.9 and 65.6 miles.
